svg.text: Pinion: bought, module 4, 14 teeth, 35 face, bored 25, keyed and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: held by a set screw. Its teeth line up with the gear's face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the shaft runs in two 25 mm flange bearings on the cheeks,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 756 mm above the ground and 196 mm above the drum centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The pinion sits outside the right bearing, inside the guard.

svg.text: meshing the gear; a feeler shows backlash of 0.2 to 0.5 mm.
